youtube.titulo: How a power bank stores energy 🔋 Stuck in 2026, Ep. 2
youtube.descricao:
Kip is stuck in 2026 and his Chrono-Band is dead. Ben hands him a power bank, and Kip finds out how a lithium-ion battery really works: lithium ions drift through a thin separator inside, while the electrons are forced to take the long way, out through the wire, powering whatever is plugged in. Charging pushes everything back. Then the band lights up for three seconds and shows a machine with four empty slots.

Episode 2 of 6 of "Stuck in 2026". Which part should Kip find next? Comment below.

The future world in this video (Lumen, wireless city power, the Chrono-Band and the time machine) is fiction. The battery explanation is based on how lithium-ion cells work (sources: U.S. Department of Energy "How Lithium-ion Batteries Work", Argonne National Laboratory "Science 101: Batteries", LG Energy Solution, Popular Science). Never open or puncture a lithium battery.
